column1: # Deutsch (de) interface catalog for DeckCraft (Tinta Presenta). Machine-assisted; needs native review.
# craft-i18n catalog format. Written from the meaning of the English text; rows shared with the
# Tinta forks of PdfCraft, WordCraft and GridCraft reuse their wording. No other product's localisation.
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation
#   context  empty here. escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. {name} placeholders must appear in
#            both columns, and a trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
